## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1862 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 1125 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 60.4 per cent. The figures provide a summary of participation following the invitation activity and indicate the proportion of invited people who attended.

The attendance total is reported alongside the invitation total to support a clear review of engagement. The rate is calculated from the number invited and the number attending, and is included for monitoring and routine reporting purposes.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1613 invitations. No reminder messages were recorded, with the reminder figure shown as 0. These contact figures are included to support review of the communication activity associated with the outreach work.

Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments. This follow-up remains part of the ongoing contact process for people who did not attend as expected.

Prepared by G. Evans.
